After a lot of research  and reading a ton of reviews I decided to purchase these and the minute I opened them I was completely surprised. I took pictures and sent them to several makeup artist I work with showing them these are identical to the ardell demi wispies we all purchase for a ridiculous amount in store. I placed another order for three more sets within two

I bought a small pack of these first to see if I liked the product (style, feel, look, etc.), they were my first go at false eyelashes and I absolutely fell in love with them immediately. From the moment I opened them I knew I'd love them. Demi wispies have that night length at the edge of my eyes, but are shorter toward the inner part of my eye...making them look dramatic and gorgeous. I adhere them using Duo white to clear glue (the blue package) and a tool I bought from Target. Once they're o
Love these Lashes!! INCREDIBLE deal for quality and quantity. Definitely one of my favorite lash brands.

reviews.t: Not too little for casual, not too much for going out.
reviews.x: I am bit conscious usually about false eyelashes as some can look bit over the top but these eyelashes look very natural and I am very pleased with the way they look. These lashes are amazing, their so light weight which is a relief because other brand felt so heavy on my eyes. I love how they look on my eyes. Not too little for casual, not too much for going out.

I received these lashes super fast! I absolutely love the quality of them. They are similar to the Ardell Demi Wispies. The band is perfect and flexible. I have used them on a few brides recently for trials since I just got them a few days ago, and they LOVED the way they looked. I will for sure be buying these again in the future.

Love these lashes! They’re pretty similar to the Ardell Demi Whispies I am a professional makeup artist specializing in weddings and I used these this past weekend on all of my bridesmaids and they looked great! Tried them out on myself the day before and was very pleased especially for the price!

I love these eyelashes!  They were easy to apply and stayed on all day.  I got many compliments as to the beauty of my lashes.  I would buy these again. These lashes curved with my natural eyelash and I did not need to trim. I have tried other brands and these are the best I have purchased.

Lightweight, fluffy and natural look. Nice and light wispy lashes and great for a day lash or an evening lash. Easy to apply!  I love it. Also they’re reusable whereas most lashes I end up throwing out. Bargain really.

I’m a makeup artist and go through a lot of strip lashes. When I received these I was shocked at the quality for the price. They have great bands and are no different in my opinion than Ardell Demi wispies.

I was hesitant to purchases these lashes as they seemed to good to be true.  I normally pay three times as much for a 1/3 of the quantity.  These lashes are GREAT - very natural looking and easy to apply.  I cut mine in 1/2 and just use on corners and they cut very easily and the band is very thin so they look great on.  Will be re-purchasing many time.  I would highly recommend this product for anyone looking for subtle, natural looking lashes that do not cost a fortune.

I have been ordering and using these lashes for over a year. They are the perfect lashes for everyday use. I get complimented every time i wear them. Easy to apply & quick delivery. Definitely a staple in my beauty regimen.

reviews.t: The BEST lashes!!!! Great quality!!!! Demi Wispie who?
reviews.x: Seriously if you're thinking about buying them just do it, I promise you will not regret it!!! I'm really-realllly picky when it comes to lashes because there are a ton of cheap quality lashes out there on the market where the lashes are cut so sloppy and uneven, or look and feel way too heavy, plastic-y, and fake, but these Jimire ones are such AMAZING QUALITY!! The band is so lightweight and really comfortable you wont even feel them when you are wearing them. They are a dupe for the Ardell De

I am so excited about these eyelashes! They look so  good. The price and value exceeds my expectation. I am use to paying $11 plus tax for 5 pair of eyelashes. I literally have 20 for that price! They look so natural but give a pop at the same time. I was very hesitant at first, but after reading the reviews, I said, “I gotta try these!” I am very well impressed. I am the customer that reads reviews but, never write them. Well, today was a different day when these came in the mail! Thank you JIM

I ordered these lashes and it came with a coupon saying I could get a free pair. I emailed them back and forth I sent them my information did I needed to write a review and send pictures. I did a review and they ignored me from that point on, never contacted me. And also never sent my free pair.  The lashes were okay, I liked the clear band but they were extremely thin and very flimsy 😕🤷🏻‍♀️

reviews.t: Best lashes for the best prices!! SERIOUSLY!
reviews.x: Omg! I’ve been looking for some lashes that are not too thick, look natural but still give some volume to the eye. When I order this lashes I wasn’t expecting what I got. They were really cheap and I just didn’t think they were going to look so good! I don’t even feel like I’m wearing lashes when I use them! Ladies this lashes are definitely a go to!! I promise 😊

I just received my lashes and I love them they are so pretty. I like that they don’t have a thick band it makes for easy applying. They looked so good and felt natural. Great value for the price lots of lashes. I will definitely be buying more and advertising for others to buy too. Thank you very much!

I used to use these lashes exclusively, but they design has changed from demi wispies to something that looks really clown-ish. I'm really disappointed. Assuming it was a fluke, I reached out to the manufacturer and they haven't made any effort to make it right, despite promising to do so.

These lashes are very comparable to the Ardell demi wispies. They feel amazing and lightweight and with proper care, they can last a week per pair maybe even 2 weeks. Whenever I wear them they look very natural and is excellent for everyday wear.

I bought it this one based on other reviewers.  I am so disappointed that the band is so hard to shape with my eyes line.  It is not light as described.  Waste money as it is sitting there as I can't use it at all- even a single pair

reviews.t: My experience with  JIMIRE False Eyelashes
reviews.x: I use these lashes on my clients they love it because these are very comfortable and lightweight. You can use on a daily basis cause it looks so natural ,also great for events. Great price and quality
Used these on my sis-in- law ... they worked awesome. Can't get any better on the deal. Exactly what I expected. Great when you have big bridal parties too. will definitely be buying again!
These lashes are absolutely beautiful!! So fluffy and natural with an amazingly flexible band it works great for beginners and pros! I am a MUA and will definitely be repurchasing!!
These lashes are great ! I am a makeup artist and I use these on just about every person! The quality for the price is phenomenal. I will definitely purchase again.
I like the style they look really natural. They are also super light and easy to clean! A great product for the price. I would buy it again

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the lashes as a great value, offering high quality and large quantity for a low price.
Many reviewers describe the lashes as natural-looking, lightweight, and easy to apply.
Several reviewers, including makeup artists, compare them favorably to Ardell Demi Wispies.
One reviewer reports a negative experience with a promised free pair that was never sent after they submitted a review.
